headline: UNGA: Bangladesh and Pakistan premiers meet to discuss bilateral ties
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Pakistani PM Shehbaz Sharif held a bilateral meeting at the UN headquarters to explore cooperation and regional stability.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Pakistani Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif held a bilateral meeting during the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).
The meeting took place on Thursday, September 24, on the 34th floor of the UN headquarters' Secretariat Building in New York.
The two leaders engaged in constructive exchanges regarding various aspects of bilateral relations between Bangladesh and Pakistan.
Discussions focused on mutual interests, regional and international situations, and potential areas of cooperation for the benefit of the people of both nations.
Both Prime Ministers emphasized the importance of advancing relations based on mutual respect, understanding, and cooperation.
The two sides agreed to maintain regular communication and dialogue on issues of common interest to further strengthen ties.
caption:
Bangladesh and Pakistan's Prime Ministers meet at the UNGA to strengthen bilateral ties and regional cooperation.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Pakistani Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif held a bilateral meeting during the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).

The meeting took place on Thursday, September 24, on the 34th floor of the UN headquarters' Secretariat Building in New York.

The two leaders engaged in constructive exchanges regarding various aspects of bilateral relations between Bangladesh and Pakistan.

Discussions focused on mutual interests, regional and international situations, and potential areas of cooperation for the benefit of the people of both nations.

Both Prime Ministers emphasized the importance of advancing relations based on mutual respect, understanding, and cooperation.

The two sides agreed to maintain regular communication and dialogue on issues of common interest to further strengthen ties.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV

topic: PM addresses UNGA on climate change and sea level rise
headline_marked: 10m Bangladeshis threatened: [[PM urges faster global action]] on climate
headline: 10m Bangladeshis threatened: PM urges faster global action on climate
summary: The Prime Minister takes the climate fight to the UN General Assembly, highlighting the urgent risk to millions of citizens.
details: The Prime Minister of Bangladesh has called for accelerated global action to combat climate change during her debut at the UN General Assembly.
She emphasized that rising sea levels pose a direct and severe threat to approximately 10 million people in Bangladesh.
The address focused on the need for developed nations to fulfill their climate commitments to protect vulnerable coastal regions.
Bangladesh continues to lead the fight for climate justice, urging the international community to move beyond promises to concrete action.
caption:
10 million people in Bangladesh are under threat from rising sea levels. The PM takes this fight to the UN.

The Prime Minister of Bangladesh has called for accelerated global action to combat climate change during her debut at the UN General Assembly.

She emphasized that rising sea levels pose a direct and severe threat to approximately 10 million people in Bangladesh.

The address focused on the need for developed nations to fulfill their climate commitments to protect vulnerable coastal regions.

Bangladesh continues to lead the fight for climate justice, urging the international community to move beyond promises to concrete action.

Source: Dhaka Tribune
